categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Has the Tests label and fixes intermittent flaky test failures in CI by relaxing a wall-clock assertion in test/functional/interface_bitcoin_cli.py.
categories.rationale: Fixes intermittent spurious CI failures caused by tight wall-clock assertion timing under heavy host load. In interface_bitcoin_cli.py, timing jitter in Docker CI can finish ~40ms earlier than the 5-second floor, making this a useful test reliability fix that is reasonably deferrable.
